result.brief: 面向稀疏视角4D动态场景重建的高斯泼溅框架，结合区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时序先验与扩散生成伪监督，提升动态重建质量。
result.reason: Main contribution is sparse-view 4D dynamic scene reconstruction via Gaussian splatting with priors and diffusion pseudo-supervision; no video/multimodal world model or visual representation learning contribution.
